brief.concept: A two-minute founder-led-in-message, no-on-camera flagship introduction to Propeller Picks for the pinned YouTube channel: the technical research platform, its sport-specific signals, inspectable confidence and agent evidence, MLB fantasy projections, and current search traction—without unsupported win-rate claims or a fundraising ask.
brief.primary_question: What is Propeller Picks, how is its product different from a typical picks service, and what can a new user actually inspect before acting on a model signal?
brief.audience: Prospective users, channel visitors, search viewers, and prospective partners who need a concise, credible explanation of the platform and its technical approach.
brief.learning_outcome: The viewer can explain that Propeller is an independent research workspace—not a sportsbook or promise machine—and knows to examine the line, directional confidence, available sport-specific signals, and context before making a decision.
brief.cta: Start with the free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Capture current desktop and mobile product state close to render time. Detailed historical UI may be used only when clearly labelled. GA4 and GSC proof cards must identify the exact reporting period; no users, revenue, generic historic win-rate, ROI, or profit claim.
